name: convert_optA_5
description: Convert the 5 option schools on the Option A closure list to neighborhood schools - Cedar Park, TOPS, Orca, Salmon Bay, Boren STEM. Licton Springs is excluded from consideration (user: too different from the others). Note this is no longer a random draw: excluding Licton Springs leaves exactly 5 candidates, so 'choose 5' is the full set and the two earlier random combos collapse into this single scenario. Steady-state conversion semantics: each school's geozone becomes its attendance area, residents attend at the band's observed stay-rate, former lottery enrollees return to their areas' other destinations pro-rata.
